subject: Emotions
title: PTSD and Disgust
description: A quick win: understand PTSD and Disgust.

hook.text: Combat veterans often report disgust, not just fear, as a core PTSD symptom. They feel contaminated by violence.

buildup.text: Assault survivors also describe intense self-disgust. The violation feels physically present on the body.

discovery.text: Research shows disgust in PTSD predicts avoidance behavior more than fear does.

twist.text: Standard PTSD treatment targets fear circuits. But if disgust is the driver, fear protocols miss the mark.

climax.text: Disgust-informed PTSD therapy is emerging. It addresses why survivors feel 'dirty' rather than just afraid.

punchline.text: Trauma doesn't just scare you. It contaminates you.

quiz.question: What does disgust predict more than fear in PTSD?
